title: Struggling Against Global Capitalism: Women's Fight for Social and Economic Justice in Indonesia
core_idea: Examine how women in Indonesia resist inequalities generated by global capitalism by exploring the gender pay gap and the methods and workplace strategies female manufacturing workers in Jakarta and East Java (Surabaya, Sidoarjo) use to pursue economic and social justice amid risks like job termination.
tldr: An exploratory qualitative study focused on Indonesian female manufacturing workers' strategies to confront capitalist-driven inequalities—especially the gender pay gap—and achieve social and economic justice.
